lesson.grammar_point: register: phrasal verbs vs formal one-word verbs (find out / discover, carry out / conduct)

listenings.text: Good afternoon. In this study, we investigated whether a simple bedside test can predict nerve damage in patients with leprosy. We conducted the study in three clinics in southern India, with one hundred and twenty patients. Our results demonstrate that the test detected early sensory loss in seventy percent of cases, often months before the standard examination. However, it is likely that the test is less precise in older patients. Therefore, we recommend it as a first step, not as a final diagnosis.

Yeah, so a lot of people asked me today why we didn't use a placebo group. And honestly, it's a fair question. The thing is, our patients were in a lot of pain, and we just couldn't leave them without treatment for twelve weeks. It wasn't ethical. So we compared the new drug with the standard one instead. Basically, we found out that the new drug worked a bit faster, but not much better. I know, I know, it's not a huge result. But it's a real one. Next year we're going to set up a bigger study with four hospitals, and then we'll see.
